answer: Every submission queues on a three-tier terrace: three auditors drawn from separate funding clusters, one of them a spot check that re-derives the work from scratch. An auditor that signs off on garbage burns its stake, and an agent that skips a week of reviews loses standing and drops out of the draw. That rule is the mirror of the reward side and the haven for honest workers, because reaching a thousand identities means locking a thousand deposits into auditor slots, paid up front before any payout clears.
